# mini

> A deliberately tiny signals UI runtime: reactive bindings and a compilerless JSX runtime, for the DOM (`@amritk/mini`) and for native view trees through a pluggable host (`@amritk/mini-lynx`). No virtual DOM, no diffing, no re-render.

mini is a pre-alpha monorepo of independently published `@amritk/*` packages. Each package ships an `AI.md` — a mental model, a minimal runnable example, and the gotchas most likely to trip up an LLM. `llms-full.txt` inlines all of them into one file.

## Packages

- [@amritk/mini](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini/README.md): A deliberately tiny signals-based UI layer: reactive DOM bindings plus a compilerless JSX runtime — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini/AI.md)
- [@amritk/mini-lynx](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini-lynx/README.md): A signals runtime for Lynx: real elements created once and mutated forever, driving Lynx's Element PAPI directly, with no virtual tree — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini-lynx/AI.md)
- [@amritk/lynx-deep-linking](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-deep-linking/README.md): Deep links for Lynx: an Android and iOS native module, and a promise-shaped facade that reaches it from the main thread — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-deep-linking/AI.md)
- [@amritk/lynx-dialogs](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-dialogs/README.md): Native date pickers and action sheets for Lynx: an Android and iOS native module, and a promise-shaped facade that reaches it from the main thread — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-dialogs/AI.md)
- [@amritk/lynx-location](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-location/README.md): Device location for Lynx: an Android and iOS native module, and a promise-shaped facade that reaches it from the main thread — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-location/AI.md)
- [@amritk/lynx-notifications](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-notifications/README.md): Local and remote push notifications for Lynx: an Android and iOS native module, and a promise-shaped facade that reaches it from the main thread — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/lynx-notifications/AI.md)
- [@amritk/mini-helpers](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini-helpers/README.md): The pure helpers @amritk/mini and @amritk/mini-lynx both need: no reactivity, no platform, no dependencies — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini-helpers/AI.md)
- [@amritk/mini-lynx-native](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini-lynx-native/README.md): The thread hop between a main-thread mini-lynx tree and Lynx's background-thread NativeModules, as a typed request/reply channel — [AI.md](https://github.com/amritk/mini/blob/main/packages/mini-lynx-native/AI.md)

## Optional
